architecture: ColorLM v6 core plus two Kimi K3 macro capsules at ColorLM layer 12; no Coder capsule and no layer-28 K3 branch

selection.method: single-site exact counterfactual next-token NLL ablation
selection.finding: K3 is beneficial at either site in isolation, while forcing both sites causes destructive cross-layer interference; L12-only is the best measured fixed graph.

rejected_research.global_linear_router: rejected: strict leave-one-task-out underperformed the fixed-route control
rejected_research.l28_local_linear_router: rejected after stability audit: the seed-13 split passed, but only 4 of 12 random task splits passed and strict leave-one-task-out was 32.73% versus 40.0% control
rejected_research.runtime_guard: rejected_control plans are not emitted by the calibrator and are rejected by both the Python and C++ loaders

code.task: return a TypeScript number-array deduplication function

instrumentation_regression.probe: K3 residual feature dump is disabled by default and creates no production graph nodes

scope: This report proves a smaller causally selected K3 graph and a local NLL improvement on the selection set. It does not prove broad coding superiority or frontier-model parity; manual coding and Claude Code evaluation remains required.
